summary.text: Dustin Vigneault is a Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Grafton 5, in the November 3, 2026 general election; the district elects two members.
He is a U.S. Army veteran and former helicopter technician.

paragraphs.text: Dustin Vigneault was born in Bradenton, Florida, and served in the U.S. Army from 1998 to 2009.
He graduated from Bayshore High School and earned an associate degree from the State College of Florida in 2013.
His career experience includes working as a helicopter technician and IT technician lab manager, and he has been affiliated with the Civil Air Patrol.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Vigneault said he is a disabled veteran who served as a crew chief on the AH-64D Apache, including a year in Iraq, and that he moved to New Hampshire from Florida with his wife and three children.
In that survey he named protections for reproductive rights as his top priority and also listed property taxes, education funding and school safety, and rural access to doctors and housing.
